pages.title: Captain America Protecting a Child From Falling Debris with His Shield Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Captain America protecting a child from falling debris, kneeling beneath his raised shield as rocks strike its star-shaped center. The child holds his side beside the broad striped costume. Large shield rings contrast with small rubble pieces and worried facial details on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: The Flash Racing Past Cars on a Central City Street Coloring Page
pages.description: The Flash races past cars on a Central City street in this printable coloring page, with lightning shapes trailing his running pose beside a taxi and sidewalk. His chest emblem and ear bolts distinguish the costume. Windows, road markings, and a small hydrant add city details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Green Lantern Recharging His Power Ring with His Lantern Battery Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Green Lantern recharging his power ring with a lantern battery, holding his fist against the round lens beneath its curved handle. Small sparkles surround the contact point. His eye mask and chest emblem sit above broad costume sections, with the lantern's rings providing smaller coloring shapes.

pages.title: Jean Grey Levitating a Circle of Stones Beside a Lake Coloring Page
pages.description: Jean Grey levitates a circle of stones beside a lake in this printable coloring page, extending both hands beneath flowing hair and a forehead band. Curved motion marks connect the floating rocks around her costume. The coloring sheet includes an X belt buckle, shoreline ripples, and small grass tufts.

pages.title: Supergirl Rescuing a Kitten From a Tree in a City Park Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Supergirl rescuing a kitten from a tree in a city park, floating beside the branch while holding the small animal in both hands. Her cape and long hair curve behind her. Leaves, a distant bench, and the kitten's fur add smaller details to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Batgirl Riding the Batcycle Along a Gotham City Street Coloring Page
pages.description: Batgirl rides the Batcycle along a Gotham City street in this printable coloring page, leaning over the handlebars with her cape and hair flowing behind her mask. Bat emblems decorate the costume and motorcycle panels. Broad tires contrast with small belt pouches, windows, and vehicle fittings on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Nightwing Holding His Escrima Sticks on a Bludhaven Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Nightwing holding his escrima sticks on a Bludhaven rooftop, standing beneath a crescent moon with a water tower and skyline behind him. His eye mask and bird-shaped chest emblem remain prominent. The coloring sheet offers broad costume sections alongside brick lines, stars, and narrow sticks.

pages.title: The Justice League with Superman, Batman and Wonder Woman Guarding the Hall of Justice Coloring Page
pages.description: Superman, Batman, and Wonder Woman guard the Hall of Justice in this printable coloring page, standing together before its large arched facade and domed roof. Superman rests his hands at his hips between his teammates. The coloring sheet includes Wonder Woman's lasso, Batman's utility belt, and broad cape sections.

pages.title: Hulk Lifting a Giant Boulder From a Blocked Mountain Road Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hulk lifting a giant boulder from a blocked mountain road, holding the cracked rock overhead in torn shorts beside fallen rubble. A guardrail curves through the pine-covered mountains behind him. Large muscle and stone sections contrast with narrow cracks and small scattered rocks.

pages.title: Doctor Strange Opening a Circular Portal Inside the Sanctum Sanctorum Coloring Page
pages.description: Doctor Strange opens a circular portal inside the Sanctum Sanctorum in this printable coloring page, extending one hand beside a ring of curved lines and sparkles. A large circular window and bookshelves frame his high-collared cloak. Small ornaments, book spines, and patterned clothing borders add detail to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Hawkeye Aiming His Bow at a Target From a Rooftop Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Hawkeye aiming his bow at a rooftop target, drawing an arrow beside his face with a quiver strapped behind his shoulder. Buildings and a distant circular target fill the city background. The coloring sheet includes buckles, protective pads, bow fittings, and broad costume sections.

pages.title: Ant-man Riding an Ant Across a Garden Path Beside Towering Blades of Grass Coloring Page
pages.description: Ant-Man rides an ant across a garden path in this printable coloring page, holding its back beneath towering grass while wearing his detailed helmet and fitted suit. The ant's antennae curve above its large eyes and mandibles. Segmented legs, armor panels, and small path stones add varied coloring sections.

pages.title: Storm Guiding Rain Clouds Away From a Coastal Village Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Storm guiding rain clouds away from a coastal village, extending both hands from a rocky overlook as her hair and cape stream backward. Rain lines and sweeping wind marks cross the sky. Small village roofs, shoreline curves, and grass tufts border the broad costume sections.

pages.title: Shazam Catching a Falling Streetlight Before It Reaches the Sidewalk Coloring Page
pages.description: Shazam catches a falling streetlight in this printable coloring page, gripping the leaning pole with both hands above its broken base on a city sidewalk. His cape spreads beside the lightning emblem on his chest. Broad lamp and costume shapes contrast with small pavement fragments and window outlines.

pages.title: Robin Using a Grappling Hook Beside a Gotham City Clock Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Robin using a grappling hook beside a Gotham clock tower, aiming the launcher upward as its cable stretches toward the pointed rooftop. His cape sweeps behind his wide stance. The coloring sheet includes a large clock face, belt pouches, gothic windows, and simple skyline shapes.

pages.title: Dash Parr Sprinting Along a Jungle Trail with Fallen Leaves Behind Him Coloring Page
pages.description: Dash Parr sprints along a jungle trail in this printable coloring page, pumping his arms as loose leaves trail behind his mask and swept-back hair. Large tropical plants and hanging vines border the narrow route. His Incredibles emblem and open costume sections contrast with the smaller leaf outlines on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Miraculous Ladybug Spinning Her Yo-yo on a Paris Rooftop Near the Eiffel Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Miraculous Ladybug spinning her yo-yo on a Paris rooftop, with the Eiffel Tower rising behind her spotted suit and twin ponytails. Motion marks curve beside the yo-yo's round edge. The coloring sheet includes costume spots, rooftop chimneys, and the tower's smaller lattice details.

pages.title: Cat Noir Holding His Staff Beside a Rooftop Chimney in Paris Coloring Page
pages.description: Cat Noir holds his staff beside a Paris rooftop chimney in this printable coloring page, resting one hand at his hip beneath cat ears and a small collar bell. The Eiffel Tower appears beyond the rooflines. Broad suit sections contrast with his tail, hair strands, and narrow staff on the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Leonardo from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Practicing with His Katanas in the Sewer Dojo Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Leonardo practicing with two katanas in the sewer dojo, taking a wide stance beneath his tied mask and segmented turtle shell. A broad tunnel arch frames the raised blades. The coloring sheet combines large shell plates with wrapped sword handles, protective pads, and floor cracks.

pages.title: The Mighty Morphin Red Power Ranger Holding the Power Sword in a Rocky Quarry Coloring Page
pages.description: The Mighty Morphin Red Power Ranger holds the Power Sword in a rocky quarry in this printable coloring page, standing beneath a dinosaur-shaped helmet with diamond costume panels. Craggy walls and loose stones surround his boots. The coloring sheet offers broad suit areas beside the detailed sword guard and belt.

pages.title: Catboy From Pj Masks Standing Beside the Cat-car Outside Headquarters Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Catboy standing beside the Cat-Car outside PJ Masks headquarters, smiling in his striped suit near the vehicle's pointed ears and catlike front. The tall headquarters tower rises behind them with three mask panels. Curved wheels and narrow costume stripes add smaller coloring sections.

pages.title: A Young Superhero Boy Wearing an Eye Mask and Star Emblem Standing with His Hands on His Hips Coloring Page
pages.description: A young superhero boy stands with his hands on his hips in this printable coloring page, wearing an eye mask, star emblem, cape, and tall cuffed boots. His tousled hair and round belt buckle complete the pose. The blank background leaves broad costume sections and clear outlines throughout the coloring sheet.

pages.title: A Young Superhero Girl Carrying a Rescued Puppy Beside a Park Bench Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows a young superhero girl carrying a rescued puppy beside a park bench, smiling beneath her eye mask and high ponytail. Her cape drapes behind a pleated skirt and tall boots. The coloring sheet includes the puppy's floppy ears, small fur tufts, and curved bench supports.

pages.title: A Superhero Dog Wearing an Eye Mask and Cape Standing on Top of Its Doghouse Coloring Page
pages.description: A superhero dog stands on its doghouse in this printable coloring page, wearing an eye mask and flowing cape above the planked roof and arched doorway. Floppy ears, a round collar tag, and a curled tail define the character. Small grass tufts border the broad doghouse and fur sections on the coloring sheet.
